name: tl;dv
tagline: AI meeting recorder with transcripts, summaries, clips, and CRM sync

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; secondary 2026 pricing pages list Pro around $29/month and lower annual price.

verdictSummary: A DIY app can record, transcribe, summarize, and generate clips, but tl;dv's team library, CRM integrations, and meeting-bot reliability are real work.
coreLoopDIY: Join/record meetings, generate transcript and summary, tag highlights, clip segments, and export notes.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for repeatable team-wide capture and distribution, not because summaries are hard.

priorArt.name: whisper.cpp
priorArt.desc: Can power the transcription layer for a simpler local clone.

notes: Good page because it forces the reader to separate summarization from meeting operations.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for tl;dv (AI meeting recorder with transcripts, summaries, clips, and CRM sync). Requirements:

- Core loop: Join/record meetings, generate transcript and summary, tag highlights, clip segments, and export notes.
- Needs: meeting platform integration.
- Needs: speech-to-text.
- Needs: video storage.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: meeting bot upkeep; team/shared library; CRM integrations.
